description: RbNaMg₁₄O₁₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmm2 space group. Rb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.36 Å) and two longer (2.43 Å) Rb-O bond lengths. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.36 Å. There are ten inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.37 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.22 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.28 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.23 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.31 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.13 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.23 Å. In the eighth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-9°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.39 Å. In the ninth Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-15°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.24 Å. In the tenth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with nine MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-14°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.39 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Mg atoms to form distorted OMg₅ square pyramids that share corners with six ORb₂Mg₄ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-86°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-20°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra, edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ORb₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Rb and four Mg atoms to form ORb₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ORb₂Mg₄ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight ORbNaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-42°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ORb₂Mg₄ octahedra, edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Rb, one Na, and four Mg atoms to form ORbNaMg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ORbNaMg₄ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one OMg₅ square pyramid, and edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-41°. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ORbNaMg₄ octahedra, edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OMg₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-19°.
